audit-log
desc: PostToolUse hook: append every tool call to the local JSONL audit trail.

name: auto-lint
desc: PostToolUse hook: Auto-lint after file edits Only runs on .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx files

name: block-blind-grep
desc: PreToolUse hook: block SILENTLY-BLIND recursive greps. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block (with JSON permissionDecision payload)

name: block-destructive
desc: PreToolUse hook (Bash): block destructive commands. Exit 0 = allow, exit 2 = block (with a JSON permission decision).

name: block-detached-process
desc: PreToolUse (Bash) hook: an agent never leaves a process running that nobody supervises.

name: block-duplicate-spec-number
desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit|Bash: refuse the write that gives a second spec directory a number another spec directory already holds (specs/NNN-name). Exit 0 = allow, exit 2 = block.

name: block-ingress-drift
desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit|Bash: refuse the write that mints a public name nobody has ruled. Exit 0 = allow, exit 2 = block (via deny() in _lib.sh).

name: block-local-path-disclosure
desc: PreToolUse (Bash) hook: nothing that leaves this machine names a path ON this machine.

name: block-local-zone-read
desc: PreToolUse, WALL for the local-only zone (default folder name: .local-only; override with OPERATOR_LOCAL_ZONE, a regex fragment).

name: block-off-trunk-commit
desc: PreToolUse hook (Bash): refuse a `git commit` that lands off trunk.

name: block-sensitive-mcp
desc: PreToolUse hook for MCP tools: Block or warn on destructive/external-effect MCP calls. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block.

name: block-sensitive-write
desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit: Block writes to credential/config paths. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block. Every non-zero path is explicit because `set -e` is on.

name: block-silent-failure
desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit: refuse a NEW silent-failure site in code. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block.

name: checkpoint-before-change
desc: PreToolUse hook (Write | Edit | Bash): the LOCAL half of a blocker gate.

name: conflict-check
desc: PreToolUse hook: Auto-check file-scope conflicts before edits Automatic owned_paths conflict detection for non-conflicting work Only fires on Write/Edit tools

name: execute-now-stop-gate
desc: execute-now-stop-gate.sh, Stop hook. Refuses to end a turn whose FINAL assistant message offers work instead of doing it ("Want me to draft it?", "Should I run it?", "Let me know if you'd like ...")...

name: governance-egress-guard
desc: PreToolUse, EGRESS GUARD (warn + log, NON-BLOCKING).

name: inject-untrusted-warning
desc: PostToolUse hook: Inject an untrusted-data warning into the tool result stream when the tool is fetching content from an external/third-party source.

name: memory-index-cap-guard
desc: PostToolUse (Write|Edit), the vault index byte cap, checked at WRITE time.

name: outcome-capture
desc: SubagentStop hook: capture one outcome record per subagent run. Reads JSON payload from stdin (provided by Claude Code SubagentStop event).

name: platform-write-gate
desc: PreToolUse hook (Bash and mcp__*): the platform-write gate.

name: precompact-save
desc: PreCompact hook: Save a git-state snapshot before context compression. Writes a timestamped diary entry to .operator/diary/ for later /reflect synthesis.

name: scrub-secrets-on-stop
desc: scrub-secrets-on-stop.sh, Stop hook. Finds live secrets that landed in this project's session transcripts (and, with OPERATOR_SCRUB_APPLY=1, redacts them before the archive goes cold).

name: session-log
desc: Stop hook: Log session summary on session end Writes JSON to ~/.claude/session-logs/ (local record)

name: startup-load
desc: SessionStart hook: surface the project constitution (if any) and print ONE status line that says which optional parts of operator-os are configured.

name: type-check
desc: PostToolUse hook: TypeScript type check after file edits Reports errors but does not block (exit 0)

name: vault-push-on-stop
desc: Stop hook: no turn ends with a vault write that only exists on this machine.

name: vault-recall-inject
desc: PreToolUse hook (matcher: Agent), VAULT RECALL FEEDER at the delegation boundary.

name: vault-recall-prompt
desc: UserPromptSubmit hook, VAULT RECALL FEEDER for the main loop's own turns.

name: warehouse-first-gate
desc: PreToolUse (Bash) hook: structured numbers come from the warehouse through the accuracy hierarchy, never from an agent hand-summing a governed dataset in the terminal.
